snippet.title: Ruffy and the Riverside - Announcement Trailer PC and Consoles
snippet.description:
Dive into an adventure that lets you literally change the world when Ruffy and the Riverside launches June 26 on PC, Nintendo Switch, PS5, Xbox Series and Xbox One! 
 
Ruffy wields the magic SWAP to copy and paste textures to traverse an open world. Unleash your imagination to turn ice into lava, waterfalls into vines, and much more in this quirky open-world adventure. 
 
#RuffyAndTheRiverside
